defaultCellSquares.name: District Cell Size
defaultCellSquares.hint: Width of one district cell, in grid squares. 12 squares is 60 feet — one Thunderclap burst. A scene freezes its cell size the first time you paint it.

playerVisible.name: Show Overlay to Players
playerVisible.hint: When off, the district grid, damage markers, and storm positions are visible to the GM only.

overlayOpacity.name: Overlay Opacity
overlayOpacity.hint: How strongly the district overlay draws over the map on this client.

landmarkLabels.name: Show Landmark Labels
landmarkLabels.hint: Draw a small label on each landmark, visible to players, showing the hits it has taken. Independent of the storm overlay's player visibility.

autoZoneCards.name: Post Zone Damage on Commit
autoZoneCards.hint: When on, committing an advance whispers you one card per element for the creatures its zone swept over. When off, the commit is silent and the console's Post Zone Damage button sends the cards.

zoneHiddenTokens.name: Sweep Hidden Tokens
zoneHiddenTokens.hint: When on, tokens you have hidden are caught by storm zones like any other. Tempest tokens are always exempt.

elements.heading: The Three Tempests
elements.downIndicator: This Tempest is at 0 HP — mark it destroyed when the scene calls for it.

storm.heading: Advance the Storm
storm.hazardTurnHint: Rolls 1d3 for the anchor, rolls a random sector, fills it with the matching template, and whispers you one card. A destroyed anchor falters and nothing is placed.
storm.proposalHint: Proposed moves show as dashed ghosts on your canvas only. Players see nothing until you commit.
storm.pendingZones: {count} creature(s) swept by the last commit.

templates.heading: Place a Template
templates.armed: Click the map to place the template.
templates.aim: Click again to aim the cone.

cells.heading: Districts
cells.rolledHint: The rolled sector is highlighted on the map for every player until you clear it or commit the round.
cells.cellSquaresFrozen: This scene's cell size is fixed at {squares} squares. Erase every painted cell to change it.

card.scaled: The template is scaled to fill the district. The area above is the rule's — resolve the effect against it.
card.collateral: Place the sector's collateral marker and name what is about to be lost. It resolves at the start of the hazard's next turn unless the heroes prevent it.
card.falters: {anchor} is destroyed. The clouds strain toward {routine} and falter — the storm takes no action this round.

water.area: 30-foot cone originating from an edge or prominent watercourse in the selected sector

card.speaker: The Queen's Tempest
card.subtitle: {element} zone, round {round}
card.basicSave: Critical Success no damage; Success half damage; Failure full damage; Critical Failure double damage.
card.unrolled: {name} — no saving throw to roll; use the link above.
card.riders: Roll the damage above and apply it yourself. Pushes, prone, deafness, and persistent damage are yours to adjudicate — the module applies nothing.

wind.failure: The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] for 1 round and pushed 10 feet away from the zone's center.
wind.critFailure: Double damage; the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] for 1 minute, pushed 20 feet, and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].

water.failure: The creature is pushed 20 feet away from the flood's path.
water.critFailure: Double damage; the creature is hurled 30 feet away from the flood's path and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].

notifications.noScene: No active scene — open the Tatzlford map first.
notifications.gmOnly: Only the GM can change the storm.
notifications.noPaintedCells: Paint the town's districts before advancing the storm.
notifications.hazardFaltered: {anchor} is destroyed — the storm takes no action this round.
